body.objective: Students will be able to name hobbies.
successCriteria: I can name common hobbies in Mandarin
I can say what my hobbies are and what I like doing
I can ask a classmate about their hobbies
body.hook: What do you do after school? Play basketball, draw, listen to music, game with friends? Talking about hobbies is one of the easiest ways to connect with new people in any language. Today you'll learn to share your hobbies in Mandarin.

vocabulary.term: 玩电子游戏 wán diànzǐ yóuxì

study.title: 你的爱好是什么？
study.question: How do I talk about my hobbies in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Sentence patterns:
• 你的爱好是什么？Nǐ de àihào shì shénme? = What is your hobby?
• 我的爱好是画画。Wǒ de àihào shì huà huà. = My hobby is drawing.
• 我喜欢打篮球。Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú. = I like playing basketball.
• 我常常听音乐。Wǒ chángcháng tīng yīnyuè. = I often listen to music.
Verbs matter: basketball uses 打 dǎ (hit/play), soccer uses 踢 tī (kick).
Dialogue:
李华 Lǐ Huá：你的爱好是什么？
艾玛 Àimǎ：我的爱好是游泳和看书。你呢？
李华：我喜欢踢足球。我每个周末都踢足球。
艾玛：你也喜欢玩电子游戏吗？
李华：喜欢！我常常跟朋友一起玩。
艾玛：我不太喜欢玩电子游戏，我喜欢画画。
English support: 和 hé = and (joins nouns); 每个周末都 měi gè zhōumò dōu = every weekend; 也 yě = also; 常常 chángcháng = often; 跟朋友一起 gēn péngyou yìqǐ = together with friends; 不太喜欢 bú tài xǐhuan = don't really like.
Activity: Find someone who…: ask classmates "你喜欢…吗？" for six hobbies and collect a name for each "喜欢！"
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Learn hobby vocabulary with the correct verbs
Practise the 我的爱好是 and 我喜欢 patterns
Read the dialogue with a partner
Share your hobbies in three sentences
discussion: How often does Lǐ Huá play soccer?
Why do basketball and soccer use different verbs?
How do you say "don't really like"?
study.product: Write a short paragraph (5–6 sentences) in characters and pinyin about your hobbies: what they are, how often you do them, who you do them with and one hobby you don't really like.

examples.title: Hobby sentence
examples.answer: 我的爱好是游泳。Wǒ de àihào shì yóuyǒng.
examples.explore: Add a second hobby with 和.

examples.title: Right verb
examples.answer: 我喜欢踢足球。Wǒ xǐhuan tī zúqiú.

examples.title: Asking
examples.answer: 你喜欢画画吗？Nǐ xǐhuan huà huà ma?

examples.title: How often
examples.answer: 我常常看书。Wǒ chángcháng kàn shū.

practice.q: What is 听音乐 tīng yīnyuè?
What is 看书 kàn shū?
What is 画画 huà huà?

practice.a: 你的爱好是什么？Nǐ de àihào shì shénme?
我喜欢打篮球。Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.

practice.q: What does 常常 chángcháng mean?
Why do basketball and soccer use different verbs?
practice.a: Mandarin uses the action: 打 (hit) for basketball, 踢 (kick) for soccer.

practice.q: Translate 我不太喜欢玩电子游戏。
practice.a: I don't really like playing video games.

practice.q: Say "I play soccer with friends every weekend."
practice.a: 我每个周末都跟朋友一起踢足球。

practice.q: Why use 和 hé for "swimming and reading" but not between sentences?
practice.a: 和 joins nouns or noun phrases, not whole clauses.

misconceptions: Using 玩 wán for every sport
Using 和 to join whole sentences
exitTicket: Ask a classmate if they like a hobby.

items.q: 和 hé is used to join
How do you ask "What is your hobby?"

items.answer: 游泳, 看书, 画画, 听音乐.

items.q: Write "My hobbies are swimming and drawing."
items.answer: 我的爱好是游泳和画画。

items.q: Explain why 打 and 踢 are used for different sports.
items.answer: 打 means hit (basketball); 踢 means kick (soccer).
He plays soccer every weekend and often plays video games with friends.

items.q: Write a paragraph about your hobbies.
Explain how 和 differs from English "and."
items.answer: 和 joins nouns, not whole sentences.
